simple.meaning: סוֹף (çôwph) is a Hebrew word meaning “end.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: סוֹף (H5491) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 4:8, with occurrences in Daniel.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in סוֹף (H5491) before moving outward to related references.

firstOccurrence.englishText: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods. I told the dream before him, saying,

timeline.evidenceText: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods. I told the dream before him, saying,
Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was stricken mute for a while, and his thoughts troubled him. The king answered, “Belteshazzar, don’t let the dream, or the interpretation, trouble you.”
“ ‘But the judgment will be set, and they will take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.
“Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts much troubled me, and my face was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.”
